sources.title: Arizona Legislature Title 42 tax lien statutes

access.notes: Official statute pages are readable without authentication.

schema.evidence: Legal reference text is not a parcel or outcome dataset.

cadence.evidence: Rule packs pin source URLs and a verification date; statutory changes require a new immutable rule-pack version.

historicalCoverage.evidence: The source provides legal context, not certificate histories.

observationTimestamp.evidence: The current rule pack records a source verification timestamp.

terms.evidence: Used as a cited public-law reference, not copied as a commercial dataset.

outcomeLabels.evidence: Statutory eligibility and timing rules do not identify parcel-level outcomes.

reasons: Authoritative for dated legal context only.

access.notes: The current ArcGIS item is public and exposes a ZIP archive containing five pipe-delimited data files and a PDF field specification.

schema.evidence: The 2026-08-17 archive header and bundled Secured Master field specification were sampled directly.

cadence.evidence: The official ArcGIS item description says the archive is updated twice a month; consumers must still inspect the item modified time and archive file dates.

historicalCoverage.evidence: The bundled specification states that the data is for the current tax year.

observationTimestamp.evidence: ArcGIS item modified at 2026-08-17T16:06:49Z and archive files dated 2026-08-17; no record-level observed-at field exists.

terms.evidence: The item and download page provide accuracy, currency, and indemnification disclaimers but no explicit license grant for commercial reuse, redistribution, or model training.

outcomeLabels.evidence: The sampled 39-field schema contains parcel, deed, assessment, and sale features but no certificate sale date, redemption event, or observed-through field.

reasons: Commercial reuse and model-training permission are not explicit.
The archive has no record-level observation timestamp or redemption outcomes.
Owner and mailing fields require a reviewed privacy and retention policy.
unblockingConditions: Obtain written commercial-use and model-training terms from the Assessor or records custodian.
Approve a field-minimized schema and privacy controls.
Join only to a separately authorized, dated certificate outcome source.

sources.title: Maricopa County Lien and Delinquent Parcels GIS

authority.publisher: Maricopa County Office of Enterprise Technology

access.notes: The official county GIS application links to a public ArcGIS experience backed by query-capable feature layers. Public visibility does not grant production reuse.

schema.evidence: Layer metadata for Unsold Lien Parcels and Delinquent Tax Parcels was checked on 2026-08-29.

cadence.evidence: Layer metadata provides a last-edit timestamp but no contractual refresh cadence or freshness guarantee.

historicalCoverage.evidence: No versioned historical snapshots or certificate lifecycle history were identified in the application or layer schema.

observationTimestamp.evidence: The two reviewed layers reported data last-edit times of 2026-08-23T05:12:17Z and 2026-08-23T05:10:00Z; records have no observed-at field.

terms.evidence: The ArcGIS item terms state internal county use only, require written authorization for external use, and prohibit commercial intent, resale, or distribution except under a sublicensing agreement.

outcomeLabels.evidence: Current delinquent or unsold membership is not a dated redemption outcome and the schema has no certificate, sale, redemption, or censoring dates.

reasons: Published terms prohibit the intended external and commercial use without written authorization.
The service exposes current state, not longitudinal redemption outcomes.
Refresh cadence and record-level observation time are not published.
unblockingConditions: Obtain written authorization or a sublicensing agreement from Maricopa County.
Receive a documented update contract and historical snapshot access.
Validate certificate-level outcome and observation fields before any training use.

sources.title: Maricopa County Treasurer Tax Lien Web

access.notes: The official county payment page links to the Treasurer domain, whose public landing page describes Tax Lien Web as a certificate-holder account monitoring service.

schema.evidence: No authenticated account, export contract, or API schema was inspected.

cadence.evidence: No update guarantee or export cadence was verified.

historicalCoverage.evidence: The public description says users can monitor their accounts but does not state the historical certificate coverage.

observationTimestamp.evidence: No record schema or export was available for inspection.

terms.evidence: Portal terms, automated access rights, export rights, and model-training rights were not verified.

outcomeLabels.evidence: The portal may contain certificate-holder events, but no redemption-date, terminal-event, or observed-through schema was verified.

reasons: The source requires a certificate-holder account and no supported integration contract is verified.
Schema, history, timestamps, export rights, and training rights are unknown.
unblockingConditions: Obtain a county-supported API or export agreement and written terms.
Use user authorization without collecting or repurposing Treasurer credentials.
Validate schema, tenant isolation, event dates, observation windows, and permitted uses.

access.notes: Realauction publicly lists Maricopa sales, but a current Treasurer statement of platform authority and a stable data interface were not verified.

schema.evidence: No current official sale-file schema or stable export was sampled.

cadence.evidence: The platform is sale-oriented and can be unavailable or materially different outside an active sale cycle.

historicalCoverage.evidence: No supported historical sale-results archive was identified.

observationTimestamp.evidence: No current export schema was available for review.

terms.evidence: Automated acquisition, redistribution, retention, and model-training terms were not verified.

outcomeLabels.evidence: Auction listings or results do not by themselves provide later redemption dates and right-censoring observation windows.

reasons: Current county authority, stable schema, historical coverage, and reuse rights are unverified.
The platform does not establish longitudinal redemption outcomes.
unblockingConditions: Verify the current Treasurer-platform relationship from an official source.
Obtain supported data access and written commercial terms.
Capture immutable sale snapshots with source timestamps and checksums.

access.notes: The existing platform accepts tenant-scoped CSV uploads and records user_upload provenance.

schema.evidence: Schema is detected per import and normalized through the existing import adapter boundary.

cadence.evidence: Each upload is a discrete user event, not a subscribed source feed.

historicalCoverage.evidence: The platform cannot infer the file's historical completeness.

observationTimestamp.evidence: The platform records when it received the file but does not treat that time as the source record's observation time.

terms.evidence: The platform does not yet capture a source authority, license, or permitted-use attestation for each upload.

outcomeLabels.evidence: User fields are not accepted as verified training labels without an approved source manifest and dated outcome contract.

reasons: The upload is real user evidence but does not prove county authority, completeness, freshness, or label integrity.
unblockingConditions: Add per-upload source authority, as-of date, terms, and permitted-use attestation before broader use.
Require an approved source manifest before any uploaded field can enter model training.

trainingDatasetCard.intendedTask: Estimate time to certificate redemption with explicit right censoring and competing terminal events for a verified purchase-time cohort.
trainingDatasetCard.unitOfAnalysis: one legally identified certificate of purchase for one parcel and sale date
trainingDatasetCard.requiredFeatureTiming: Every feature must have an observed_at timestamp no later than the prediction as_of timestamp.
trainingDatasetCard.censoringRule: A certificate without a verified terminal event is right-censored at observed_through, never labelled as non-redemption merely because no event was found.
trainingDatasetCard.splitPolicy: Use an out-of-time holdout by sale cohort and keep later observations out of earlier feature snapshots.
blockers: No source has verified commercial model-training permission for the intended corpus.
No verified bulk source provides certificate identity, sale date, redemption date, terminal event, and observed-through time together.
The current GIS source is restricted and exposes only current state without longitudinal labels.
The Assessor source provides useful parcel features but only current-tax-year coverage and no redemption outcomes.
The authenticated Treasurer portal's schema, export rights, historical coverage, and supported integration path remain unknown.
unblockingConditions: Secure written commercial-use and model-training authorization from each records custodian or data provider.
Acquire immutable historical certificate and redemption extracts with event and observation timestamps.
Define and verify entity resolution from certificate to APN without silent many-to-one collapse.
Approve privacy, retention, access, correction, and dataset withdrawal controls.
Publish a versioned dataset manifest and data-quality report before training.
